'''Burra fish''' were a species of [[Fish/Legends|fish]] native to the planet of [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]].<ref name="SWG">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref> The [[Talisman of the Burra Fish]] turned the user into a burra fish.<ref name="Book of Sith">''[[Book of Sith: Secrets from the Dark Side]]''</ref>

{{Creature-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Burra fish first appeared in the [[1994]] novel ''[[The Courtship of Princess Leia]]'' written by [[Dave Wolverton]]. The fish was first pictured in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a massively multiplayer online role-playing game developed by [[Sony]] and published by [[LucasArts]], prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].
